headline: DPSC Limited reports 2nd CoC meeting in IPCL insolvency process
sum: DPSC Limited has intimated the NSE of the 2nd Committee of Creditors meeting in the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) of India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL). The post facto intimation indicates ongoing creditor deliberations in the insolvency proceedings.
detail: DPSC Limited, a power-sector entity, has disclosed to NSE that the 2nd meeting of the Committee of Creditors for India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL) has been convened under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The notification is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015, indicating that DPSC holds a material interest (likely as a shareholder or related party) in IPCL's resolution. The post facto nature of the intimation suggests the meeting has already occurred and outcomes are being formally communicated to the market.
